caption: The drawing depicts a metallic vessel with two main components: an upper cylindrical bucket and a lower rounded base. The upper part of the vessel features a hammered texture with a repeating scalloped pattern around the rim, and it is colored in shades of aged copper with hints of greenish patina. Attached to the top are two round metal loops on opposite sides, through which a thick, sinuous handle is threaded and arched, also colored in the same coppery tone. The lower part of the vessel, serving as a base, is wider and more bulbous in shape, decorated with a series of petal-like protrusions encircling its surface. The vessel sits on a slightly raised, circular pedestal. The drawing uses a muted color palette, predominantly comprising browns, reds, and greenish hues to suggest oxidation on the metal.
title: Hammered-Copper Bucket
